high_traffic.failure_point: Gemini API and Firestore rule queries start queuing up; high HTTP 429 risk if API limits are exceeded.

rapid_api_requests.failure_point: Lack of debouncing/throttling on frontend actions exhausts user quota within 10 seconds, causing immediate UX failure.

concurrent_users.failure_point: Concurrent edits on identical user configurations lead to 'last write wins' data overwrites and dirty-reads.

network_failures.failure_point: Without Firestore Offline Persistence explicitly enabled, any network drop leads to immediate client UI freeze and potential data-loss.

database_delays.failure_point: Large, un-paginated queries without startAfter/limit block the client visualization (D3/Recharts) and cause UI lagging.

server_restarts.failure_point: Serverless container recycling results in 3-5 second API latency spikes, degrading interactivity during initial loads.

large_datasets.failure_point: Unmemoized SVG canvas rendering locks the main browser thread under heavy D3 force-directed simulations.

memory_pressure.failure_point: Lack of proper cleanup in React's useEffect when destroying D3 canvas structures triggers slow-burn memory leaks.

cpu_pressure.failure_point: Heavy mathematical layouts and nested Zod schema validations blocking the single-threaded event loop.
